items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I even hear in Boston, the Herb Pomeroy Band that everyone raves about

ctx.x: To carry on in that is something new. Because those things had a big mass public and still had fine musicians, too. Duke and -- but to carry on. I'd love to see the arrangers that Woodie is hiring now and Maynard Ferguson and these others, and stuff that I hear. I even hear in Boston, the Herb Pomeroy Band that everyone raves about, I just don't see that it's the important thing that's missing in the big band field, to bring that big public back into the big band.

Well, Steve Wilson -- do any of you three guys want to get on with your dad, because I know it will be interesting in years to come to know how progressive you are and how you all are looking at this, which to me is just wonderful.
